instagram.creative_rules: Full-screen vertical. Quick engaging hook. Tap-through design. Poll or question sticker aesthetic.

tiktok.creative_rules: Native story feel. Quick cut energy. Bold text hooks. Authentic behind-the-scenes.

facebook.creative_rules: Quick story update. Poll or question format. Casual engaging tone.

youtube.creative_rules: YouTube Shorts format. Quick vertical content. Hook in first second.

meta.creative_rules: Full-screen story. Quick engaging format. Swipe-up action.

pinterest.creative_rules: Idea pin format. Quick visual story.

general.master_prompt: Design a full-screen vertical story or reel graphic for {{ .Title }}. 9:16 vertical format. Bold hook text at top third. Quick engaging visual about {{ .Description }}. Casual authentic feel — not overly polished. Interactive element like poll option, question, or swipe prompt. Trending gradient or bold color background. Bold sans-serif text. Story/Reel native aesthetic.
general.video_prompt: Vertical story/reel for {{ .Title }}. Quick hook in first 2 seconds. Behind-the-scenes or quick reveal format. Bold text overlays. Casual authentic energy. {{ .Description }}.
general.carousel_prompt: Story sequence for {{ .Title }}. Each slide: full-screen vertical with bold text progressing a quick story about {{ .Description }}. Tap-through narrative. Engaging hook → build → reveal → CTA.

platform_adaptation.instagram: Story sticker aesthetic. Poll/question element. Casual.
platform_adaptation.tiktok: Native reel energy. Bold hook text. Fast.

beauty_skincare.master_prompt: Design a vertical beauty story/reel graphic for {{ .Title }}. Full-screen 9:16. Bold hook text about {{ .Description }}. Behind-the-scenes beauty routine feel. Casual authentic design. Poll element like 'Morning or Night routine?' Interactive story aesthetic.
beauty_skincare.video_prompt: Beauty story/reel for {{ .Title }}. Quick routine reveal. Product showcase. Bold text hooks. Casual BTS energy. {{ .Description }}.
beauty_skincare.carousel_prompt: Beauty story sequence for {{ .Title }}. Tap-through routine reveal about {{ .Description }}. Each frame: bold text + beauty visual. Casual aesthetic.

platform_adaptation.instagram: Beauty story sticker feel. Poll element.

beauty_skincare.product_rule: vertical story format, casual authentic, interactive feel
